name: Campaigner
body:
You sleep well under any circumstance.

Prerequisite: Endurance.

Benefit: You sleep well and easily. You require only half the normal amount of rest to remove exhaustion and fatigue: 30 minutes and 4 hours, respectively. You can sleep in heavy armor or in any other extremely uncomfortable position or situation without becoming fatigued. Finally, you do not suffer penalties on Perception checks when asleep.
